description: Anomaly detection in events on a timeline will provide the user with quick insight regarding the status of their events. The dataset provided will be calculated and presented in a concise and clear fashion. The many parameters available lets you form the output to fit your needs. You need to see which services had the most encounters above normal in the last hour or day? Anomaly detection has you covered. Curious what items had the lowest output below the expected amount in the last week or month? This visual will help you out. Unsure if the expected area is too narrow or too wide? The control is in your hands. This visual can be used in many different settings and will provide you with a sturdy tool for your data analysis.
